Dead Sea Scrolls scholar Kipp Davis joins Danny Jones to say he lost his faith after he decoded the oldest Bible texts. Davis is a scholar of the scrolls and the Hebrew Bible. His tale is one of a faith undone by study.

Davis tells how years with the scrolls showed him cracks in the tales he was raised on. He walks through what the old texts truly say and where they clash with the church's tale. Jones asks what he holds to now. Listeners get a rare tale of a scholar whose work cost him his creed. The library holds the talk as an archive record.
